title: Safari browser data
whyItMatters: Safari's History.db, bookmarks and download list show where the user went online and what they brought onto the Mac.
source: Apple/Mac forensics reference: ~/Library/Safari holds History.db, Bookmarks.plist and Downloads.plist - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/safari-history
notes: TCC-protected: without Full Disk Access a live scan gets 'Operation not permitted', even as root. Files, databases and plists are never opened or parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Safari export the bookmarks you want to keep with File > Export > Bookmarks to a folder you keep.
cleanup.signOut: If Safari data syncs through iCloud, turn that off in the iCloud settings under your Apple Account.
steps: Quit Safari so its files are not in use.
In Safari choose History > Clear History and clear all history.
Delete the Safari folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: History, bookmarks and the download list leave this Mac. Anything not exported cannot be recovered from it.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Clear your browsing history in Safari on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/clear-your-browsing-history-sfri47acf5d6/mac
